title: Crete Wedding Packages and What They Include
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW guide. Model: content/posts/santorini-wedding-packages (same no-price approach). Covers what Crete venue packages include and leave out, venue fee versus package versus a planner, and how to compare quotes like for like, from what venues publish about their own packages. NO prices, fees, amounts, percentages, per-person figures, deposit sizes or 'from' prices; 'charged on top' or 'a fee applies' only where a venue says so.

OVERLAP: this guide owns 'crete wedding packages'. Greece packages guide (draft) keeps Greece terms; the all-inclusive comparison (draft, /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages-all-inclusive) keeps the all-inclusive variant; the Crete venues guide (/destination-weddings/crete-wedding-venues) and 'Wedding in Crete' (/destination-weddings/wedding-in-crete) keep venue and planning intent; link both prominently. SEO checks crete wedding packages and variants (all inclusive, chania, elounda, elopement package, cost).

Sections: intro; 4 one-sentence takeaways; types of Crete package; what packages include (by venue); what's left out or charged on top (questions); ceremony type inside a package; venue package vs venue fee vs a planner; east vs west Crete only where facts support it; comparing two quotes (inclusions in writing, deposits and cancellation, exclusive use and days, music times, weather plan, level access, quote currency, contract language); legal in brief (as at November 2026; link /destination-weddings/wedding-in-crete); Australian angle (one Advisor line: quotes in AUD for Australian couples, inclusions confirmed in writing; insurance as a question); FAQ; close.
